Di punishment na prison for 2 years. Police no fit arrest am without court paper (warrant).

sections.title: Other conspiracies
sections.chapter: Chapter 54: Conspiracy
sections.text:
Any person who conspires with another to effect any of the following purposes [L.N. 112 of 1964.]
(1) to prevent or defeat the execution or enforcement of any Act, law, statute, or order; or
(2) to cause any injury to the person or reputation of any person, or to depreciate the value of any property of any person; or
(3) to prevent or obstruct the free and lawful disposition of any property by the owner thereof for its fair value; or
(4) to injure any person in his trade or profession; or
(5) to prevent or obstruct, by means of any act or acts which if done by an individual person would constitute an offence on his part, the free and lawful exercise by any person of his trade, profession, or occupation; or
(6) to effect any unlawful purpose; or
(7) to effect any lawful purpose by any unlawful means, is guilty of a misdemeanor and is liable to imprisonment for two years.
An offender cannot be arrested without warrant.
sections.pidgin: Dis section talk about other plans together. If person plan together with another person to stop or defeat di execution or enforcement of any Act, law, statute or order; to injure person or im reputation, or reduce di value of person property; to stop or block di free and lawful sale of property by di owner for im fair value; to injure person for im trade or profession; to stop or block, by act wey go be offence if one person do am, di free and lawful exercise of person trade, profession or occupation; to do any unlawful purpose; or to do lawful purpose by unlawful means, e don commit misdemeanour (small crime). Di punishment na prison for 2 years. Police no fit arrest am without court paper (warrant).

sections.title: Conspiracy in trade dispute
sections.chapter: Chapter 54: Conspiracy
sections.text:
(1) The provisions of sections 516, 517 and 518 of this Code shall not apply to an agreement or combination of two or more persons to do or procure to be done any act in contemplation or furtherance of a trade dispute if such act committed by one person would not be punishable as an offence:
Provided that nothing in this section shall exempt from punishment any person guilty of a conspiracy for which a punishment is provided by any other enactment:
And provided further that nothing in this section shall affect the law relating to riot, unlawful assembly, breach of the peace, or sedition, or any offence against the State. [L.N. 112 of 1964.]
(2) For the purposes of this section-
"offence" does not include an offence punishable only by a fine; and "trade dispute" has the same meaning as in the Trade Unions Act. [Cap. Tl4.]
sections.pidgin: Dis section talk about plan together for trade dispute. Sections 516, 517 and 518 of dis Code no apply to agreement or combination of 2 or more persons to do or cause to do act for trade dispute, if di act no go be offence when one person do am. But dis section no free person wey commit conspiracy wey another law give punishment for, and e no touch di law about riot, unlawful assembly, breach of di peace, sedition, or any offence against di State. For dis section, 'offence' no include offence wey na only fine dem dey punish, and 'trade dispute' get di same meaning as for di Trade Unions Act.

sections.title: Accessories after the fact to felonies
sections.chapter: Chapter 55: Accessories after the fact
sections.text: Any person who becomes an accessory after the fact to a felony is guilty of a felony and is liable, if no other punishment is provided, to imprisonment for two years.
sections.pidgin: Dis section talk about person wey help another person hide or run after felony don happen. If person become accessory after di fact to felony, e don commit felony (serious crime). Di punishment na prison for 2 years if di law no give another punishment.

sections.title: Accessories after the fact to misdemeanours
sections.chapter: Chapter 55: Accessories after the fact
sections.text: Any person who becomes an accessory after the fact to a misdemeanor, is guilty of a misdemeanor and is liable to a punishment equal to one half of the greatest punishment to which the principal offender is liable on conviction.
sections.pidgin: Dis section talk about person wey help another person hide or run after misdemeanour don happen. If person become accessory after di fact to misdemeanour, e don commit misdemeanour (small crime). Di punishment na half of di greatest punishment wey di main offender fit face if di court find am guilty.

sections.title: Accessories after the fact to simple offences
sections.chapter: Chapter 55: Accessories after the fact
sections.text: Any person who becomes an accessory after the fact to a simple offence, is guilty of a simple offence and is liable to a punishment equal to one half of the greatest punishment to which the principal offender is liable on conviction.
sections.pidgin: Dis section talk about person wey help another person hide or run after simple offence don happen. If person become accessory after di fact to simple offence, e don commit simple offence (small crime). Di punishment na half of di greatest punishment wey di main offender fit face if di court find am guilty.
